text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer! Wanna do "something 
like" a part-time job with me?
choice_data_list: Something like that?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Apparently the ramen shop 
manager is doing some "Customer 
Satisfaction Survey for Service 
Improvement" thing.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The more samples the better, so they told 
me to bring my Trainer along!

"...Which was a complete lie. In truth, 
this was merely an excuse to invite her 
out for ramen."

Inside the ramen shop, her friends and the 
convenience store manager had already 
gathered to throw her a surprise party!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if you have something to do, don't 
worry about it! It's only if you feel like 
it.
choice_data_list: No, I'd love to take you up on that.
No, I'd love to go.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hallo hallo, Boss~! Your customer 
Ines-chan is here—

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager & 2 Others
text_block_list.text: Table for one, right this way~♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Wh-What are you doing? Even the 
manager...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, they got the party size wrong! My 
Trainer's with me, so that's two people—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Wait, Trainer's changing?!
choice_data_list: Please, have a seat here.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? What? What do you mean!?

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Here is the first course on the menu: 
"Nutrient-Packed Salad, Created in 
Collaboration with the Convenience Store 
Manager." ...And done. I'll share the 
recipe with ya later!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Whoa, it's so cute and looks 
delicious! My little sisters might 
actually eat this...

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text:
Next up is... the 'Veteran Part-Timer's 
Certified Staff Meal Rice Bowl'! Hehe, you 
can't resist this, can you?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wah!! Yeah, yeah! It's low in fat and 
keeps you full for a long time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The drink is right here... The "Demon of 
Posting! Instant Power Juice"!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ummm... She said, "I cannot come in person 
due to work obligations, but please enjoy 
this sports drink our company is 
developing"!
choice_data_list: And for dessert—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"A Quick Run With Us"! Like, we'll 
accompany you on a run anywhere, anytime~☆

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
They're really catering to our every 
need~! But—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
This whole situation makes no sense at 
all~~!?
choice_data_list: Well, it was bound to turn out that way.

Well, it makes sense it turned out like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Truth is, the whole "customer 
satisfaction survey to improve services" 
thing was a lie.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: R-Really!? Then what on earth is this?
choice_data_list:
This is a token of gratitude to you from 
the managers.

This is a token of gratitude to you from 
the managers.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Repaying... a favor...?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text:
Fu, thanks as always. For working so 
cheerfully and helping out the shop.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
I lost count of how many times her 
cheerfulness and hard work saved the 
day...

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text:
So this is my way of paying you back for 
everything up until now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... ...Geez, I'm the one who 
should be thanking you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Still, in that case, we've gotta properly 
accept their kindness, right?"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
All righty! In that case, I'll gladly dig 
into this thank-you menu!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: *chomp*... *nibble, nibble*...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phaaaah! Thank you for the meal! It was 
all sweet just the way I like it, 
everything was delicious~!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome! So, how did it go? I hope 
they liked it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that obvious?! After receiving such 
a wonderful favor in return from everyone 
I love so much...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: —It's definitely the best!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Thank gooooodness...!
choice_data_list: Looks like it was a huge success, huh!

Looks like it was a huge success, doesn't 
it!
Sorry for keeping it a secret...!
I'm sorry for keeping it a secret...!
I feel like I understand how you feel now
I feel like I understand how you feel now

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Thank gooooodness...!
choice_data_list: Looks like it was a huge success, huh!

Looks like it was a huge success, doesn't 
it!
Sorry for keeping it a secret...!
I'm sorry for keeping it a secret...!
I feel like I understand how you feel now
I feel like I understand how you feel now

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Geez, it frustrates me to admit it, but 
that was a great surprise! You completely 
had me fooled.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Still, surprises really are nice! Yeah, 
I'd love it if you did that again~.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Which means, with races, part-time jobs, 
and all sorts of stuff, I just gotta keep 
giving it my all~♪

Everyone present smiled warmly. Repaying 
Ines Fujin seems to have been a massive 
success.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not mad, really... Oh, or did you 
want me to be angry?"
choice_data_list: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well, she did lie to us, after all. As 
punishment...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"This time, it's my turn to thank 
everyone♪"

Amidst such heartwarming exchanges, our 
plan to repay Ines Fujin came to a 
successful conclusion.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: My feelings are—
choice_data_list:
That feeling of happiness when someone's 
pleased with what you did.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, I see.

While understanding Ines Fuujin's 
feelings, returning the favor to her 
turned out to be a success.
